mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = 'super_admin' AND status = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, password_hash AS passwordHash, status FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS userId, s.id AS sessionId, u.status, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, s.expire_time AS expireTime, s.revoke_time AS revokeTime FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_session s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND s.id = #{sessionId}
SELECT password_hash FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{hash}, must_change_password = 0, password_change_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{userId}
